integrity: All finite graph and exact integer-matrix checks are reproducible from two independent standalone Python scripts and stored output logs; publication-priority assessment remains subject to inaccessible full-text risk.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem applies only to 576 labeled Latin squares of order four and to the degree-biased lazy switch walk. Wanless studies class quotients. A 2026 work separately analyzes the same labeled graph and its degree classes; the publicly described spectral results have been compared, but its complete PDF was inaccessible, leaving material originality uncertainty. No claimed general-order extension.
title: Exact spectrum of the order-four Latin-square intercalate-switch graph
